description: Identifies near-duplicate or highly similar text records using TF-IDF cosine similarity. Groups records above the similarity threshold into connected components and designates a canonical representative for each group. Use to deduplicate survey responses before topic modeling, find similar grant abstracts, or cluster support tickets by topic without manual labeling.

text_column.description: Column containing the text to compare

id_column.description: Column with a unique record identifier (used in canonical_id output)

similarity_threshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold for grouping (default 0.85; lower = more grouping)
